title: Dexcom G6 Battery Status Packet Error - 8Q Transmitter
body:
I've discovered an issue I'm facing with an 8Q Transmitter and the battery status. The problem I noticed is that the 'Transmitter Days', 'Resistance' and 'Temperature' values are all wrong. 

I've determined the issues to be in the way the battery status packet is handled. The problem lies in the file: com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/G5Model/BatteryInfoRxMessage.java

I've modified the code as follows and fixed the issue:
[BatteryInfoRxMessage.txt](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/files/5526927/BatteryInfoRxMessage.txt)


It looks like there are only 2 types of packet sizes, 10 and 12. Not sure when this was introduced but it must be with the new firefly transmitters since I was not having this problem up until I switched to a 8Q transmitter. 

Question that remains is why the resistance value is not being sent anymore. I tried looking for a reason but I can't find anything yet. 

I'm not familiar enough with the xDrip code to feel comfortable making a code pull request. I think it's better for someone who has more experience with the code to take a look and see how best to implement this change. It could be a G6 problem only.
